headline: Executive order adds more officials to the list of who would lead the Department of Homeland Security if top leaders cannot serve.
what_it_does: This order names additional officers to the Department of Homeland Security's order of succession. That list sets who would act as head of the department if the Secretary and other top leaders die, resign, or cannot do the job. No other details were provided beyond the title.

who_it_affects.group: Senior Department of Homeland Security officials
who_it_affects.how: Some officials are added to the line of people who could temporarily run the department if higher-ranking leaders are unavailable.

when_it_takes_effect: Not stated in the source; orders like this usually take effect when signed (November 29, 2004).
